Figure Studio

Figure Studio restyles existing MATLAB figures and exports their visible graphics data without changing the calculations that produced them.

Launch

labkit_FigureStudio_app

Workflow

Open a FIG file or choose an existing figure, select axes and graphics objects, edit presentation properties, and export the revised figure or visible data. The app is intended for presentation cleanup and inspection, not recomputing scientific results.

Behavior

Object selection follows the figure hierarchy. Edits apply to the selected graphics objects and remain visible in the preview. Data export reads plotted object data in display order and reports unsupported object types rather than inventing a table.

Outputs

  • restyled MATLAB figures;
  • exported visible line, scatter, image, or surface data where supported;
  • recoverable project state for the editing session.
